description:
Get locus-to-gene (L2G) predictions.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table l2g_prediction — one record = one locus-to-gene score of one gene at one credible set.
Key: studyLocusId, geneId.
Arguments: gene_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); study_locus_id accepts study locus id (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by score desc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.locus` counts locuss.
Rows with unknown score are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. L2G predictions for credible sets of OT 25.09; absence means the gene was not scored at the locus.

gene_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

min_score.description: Keeps rows with score >= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.5; pass null for no restriction.

study_locus_id.description: Accepts study_locus_id; resolved to one study_locus_id (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
